results.claim: The exact zero set of the complete source residual defines the source-compatible fibre.
A proper positive finite common-compression extension has strictly larger heat trace.
Continuous tensor-additive spectral complexity is logarithmic up to normalization.
The normalized exponential of a trace-class positive source operator is faithful; its standard GNS root is cyclic.
Two-sided Gram identities plus typed intertwining give a lossless source-to-base realization.
Attainment and equality rigidity select one source-equivalence class on the exact compatibility fibre.
The narrow seed reduct cannot exclude a hidden seed-annihilator block without an independently owned selection law.
Spectral minimality does not select terminal-role labels or a unique off-shell action representative.
The selected realized class exports the frozen BaseSeedPacket without terminal fitting.

The frozen P3/CLP3 candidate realizes a complete seven-generator Clifford and two-record presentation with a faithful cyclic 256-dimensional source representation, typed support flag and two ordered ports.
The explicit P3/CLP3 instantiation does not prove physical ownership, unrestricted ambient exhaustivity, equality rigidity, or Nature-authorized BaseSeedPacket export.
One nonnegative source-fidelity, two-sided-Gram and Schur-neutral body-square action jointly realizes P4--P7 after a complete source language is supplied.
A source action cannot certify completeness of the residual language used to define its own admissible fibre; P1 remains source data or an independently proved exhaustivity theorem.
An independent component zero-jet can reverse global selection without changing the local Hodge packet, so unrestricted Nature ownership does not follow from the single-action witness.
For a finite independently frozen physical source algebra with faithful state, the seed language is exhaustive exactly when its regular-GNS span has full ambient rank.
A missing same-component relation, a hidden central component, or a nonfaithful ambient state defeats an otherwise local source-completeness test.
The P3/CLP3 regular-GNS control has rank 256 on its declared 256-dimensional ambient, but is not a physical P1 certificate because that ambient was not independently derived from the seed candidate.
The independently declared pre-body PUSC simple envelope gives a candidate ambient Cl_10(C) isomorphic to M_32(C), with faithful normalized-trace GNS algebra dimension 1024.

Under the envelope-ontic interpretation and a physical typed embedding, the 256-dimensional P3/CLP3 algebra is component-complete but fails global P1 by the exact faithful-GNS rank ratio 256/1024=1/4.
The same local P3 packet is compatible with an ontic-envelope branch and a metric-auxiliary branch, so local seed data do not select the ambient ontology; Nature ownership remains open.

In the declared 32-dimensional Cl_10 representation, the P3 algebra is the four-block algebra selected by the commuting chirality and record involutions, with four rank-eight central projections and equal normalized-trace weights.
The homogeneous connectors u=gamma_8 and v=gamma_10 give the exact algebra-dimension ladder 256, 512, 512, 1024; within this declared connector class both are necessary and together generate M_32(C).

A single nonnegative Hilbert-Schmidt connector-defect action has a zero-defect Cl_10 witness and rejects absent, rescaled and wrong-grading connector controls once the connector domain and relation grammar are source-owned.

The connector action cannot derive the existence of its own typed u/v variables from P3-local data, and simple M_32(C) has no nontrivial star-ideal quotient to M_8(C)^{oplus 4}; Nature-level connector ownership remains open.

Given an ontic Cl_10 envelope, the canonical seven-dimensional P3 role subspace, and an even Clifford-compatible embedding of the equal-weight binary record algebra, the record involution splits the three-dimensional complement into a two-dimensional minus eigenspace and a one-dimensional plus eigenspace.

The prior u/v connector pair is a gauge-fixed orthonormal frame of that single graded record--Clifford embedding; any tested O(2)-rotated frame closes the same Cl_10 algebra, so u and v need not be separately owned source primitives.

The current P3/PUSC plus binary-record reduct does not entail the graded embedding: odd-twist and chirality-misaligned involutions preserve the local four-block P3/record data while violating global evenness or vector-complement preservation.
Physical source selection and Nature occupation of the graded record--Clifford embedding remain unproved; therefore physical P1 exhaustivity and BaseSeedPacket export remain unauthorized.
